error_pattern: When writing a database schema model from a different-domain example, the generated model copied the example's field names instead of the required fields, so validation failed on undeclared fields.
principle: when adapting a different example, take structure from the example but every name and field from the task's own requirements.
prompt_addendum: when adapting a different example, take structure from the example but every name and field from the task's own requirements.

error_pattern: When writing a validation predicate with inclusive boundaries, the first implementation used strict comparisons so the boundary cases returned the opposite of the specification.
principle: when writing a validation predicate, use the opposite of the specification, and test the boundary cases.
prompt_addendum: when writing a validation predicate, use the opposite of the specification, and test the boundary cases.

error_pattern: When writing a schema relation, the generated model omitted the relation field and its scalar foreign-key field even though both were listed in the requirements.
principle: when writing a schema relation, always include the relation field and its scalar foreign-key field.
prompt_addendum: when writing a schema relation, always include the relation field and its scalar foreign-key field.

error_pattern: When a form handler returned the wrong status for missing required input, the automated check rejected the response codes.
principle: when a form handler returns a 400 error code, check the response code and the status code in the response body.

error_pattern: validation predicates used wrong comparison directions or omitted boundary cases; stub bodies appeared on hard predicates
principle: Before writing a comparison, enumerate the boundary cases from the requirements and decide true/false for each; write the comparison that matches those decisions exactly.
prompt_addendum: Before writing the comparison, list each boundary case from the requirements with its required true/false result; then write the comparison that produces exactly those results.
